evidence.quote: Neutropenic female ICR mice about 25 g (cyclophosphamide 150 mg/kg day -4 and 100 mg/kg day -1 i.p.) made renally impaired with uranyl nitrate 5 mg/kg i.p. 3 days before inoculation. Thigh inoculum about 10^5 CFU/ml standard (10^7 CFU/ml high inoculum for three isolates); treatment from 2 h after inoculation.

Meropenem 65, 30, 20, 5 mg/kg s.c. (0.2 ml) at 0, 1.5, 3, 5 h, repeated every 8 h over 24 h, to mimic human 1 g q8h (Fig. 1 legend says 60/30/20/5); groups of 3 mice; thighs harvested at 24 h. Ertapenem comparator regimen 50 mg/kg q6h. Serum PK by HPLC; sampling times and n per time not stated.

Protein binding 8% assumed for mice and humans. Footnotes: a median of >=3 MIC experiments; b fT>MIC in mice; c non-ESBL isolate; d removed from analysis (no infection established); e difference between meropenem and ertapenem efficacies.
Ertapenem columns are a comparator drug. Per-isolate CFU changes are in Fig. 3 only (not transcribed). Non-doubling MICs (e.g. 0.047) printed as is.

findings.reason: MI001 remains NOT_FOUND, resolution_status OPEN, needed_at adequacy, for Mouse per-regimen CFU response records. Its supplied origin is the proposal-reported limitation; attachment bodies were NOT_SEARCHED in that originating assessment. This reviewed item explicitly states that per-isolate CFU changes are in Fig. 3 only and not transcribed (F0003:S2:T3:A31). MICs and reported fT>MIC values cannot replace matched responses. Escalate the dependent adequacy decision; this finding does not establish absence throughout the workbook.
findings.needed_material: Source-supported CFU responses, baseline or comparator, response window, experimental units and uncertainty, linked to regimen, strain MIC and all three free-exposure indices. Coverage review must record MI001's outcome before the dependent adequacy handoff.

findings.reason: Isolate-linked MIC and fT>MIC inputs are AVAILABLE_CANDIDATE, but response-linked coverage is UNRESOLVED. CFU responses are not transcribed; baseline, untreated controls and response uncertainty are NOT_FOUND. fAUC/MIC and fCmax/MIC inputs are also NOT_FOUND. This item cannot support the equal-eligibility comparison in SC034–SC035 or new target estimation. Independent PK and exposure-summary tasks remain separately assessable.
findings.needed_material: Matched meropenem response records and source-supported exposure-response relationships, including common records, MICs, dosing histories, free basis and windows for all candidate indices.

findings.reason: F0003:S2:T3:A29 reports 65, 30, 20, 5 mg/kg and separately states that the Fig. 1 legend says 60/30/20/5. Both alternatives are retained. The first-dose amount cannot be selected silently. Dose formulation basis, the explicit origin of regimen time zero and ertapenem route are NOT_FOUND.
findings.needed_material: Review of the exact source contexts for both printed schedules and an authorized resolution or documented retained alternatives before preparation adopts a dose history.

findings.reason: F0003:S2:T3:A30 supplies an assumed protein-bound percentage, not measured fu or direct unbound concentrations. Binding method, matrix, temperature, pH, concentration range, recovery and nonspecific binding are NOT_FOUND. The wording does not explicitly identify the drug to which the assumption applies. It does not establish a human binding input or validated free-exposure conversion.
findings.needed_material: Binding-assumption provenance and drug, species and matrix applicability, or authorized direct-free or binding evidence for the intended endpoint; retain conflicts separately without averaging.

findings.reason: Body values establish isolate-linked meropenem MICs in µg/ml, with a note specifying median of >=3 MIC experiments. Method, medium, testing standard and exact replicate counts are NOT_FOUND. Seven rows carry marker d, defined as removed from analysis because no infection was established. The three high-inoculum isolates are not identified. Response matching remains unavailable.
findings.needed_material: MIC measurement context, precise isolate-specific replicate information where available, high-inoculum isolate mapping and source-supported relationships to the intended response records; preserve exclusion markers.

findings.reason: Body values establish reported mouse fT>MIC percentages paired with isolate MICs. F0003:S2:T3:A29 identifies serum PK by HPLC but supplies no concentration profiles, sampling times or n per time. The fT calculation window, denominator and profile derivation are NOT_FOUND; the 24 h treatment duration alone does not define that denominator.
findings.needed_material: Source-supported profile inputs, calculation definition, window and time origin, binding-assumption link and resolved dose history. Retain these as reported percentages without recalculation.

findings.reason: F0003:S2:T3:A28–A29 describe neutropenic, renally impaired female ICR mice, thigh inoculation, treatment starting 2 h later and a humanized meropenem schedule. They do not establish multiple meropenem regimens varying total dose and dosing interval, untreated growth controls, a response reference point or explicit PK-to-PD group correspondence. Differences across isolate MICs or comparator drugs do not establish meropenem dose-fractionation separation.
findings.needed_material: Source-supported regimen variation and infection-response context, including untreated controls and PK-to-PD correspondence. Keep index ranking unresolved if the design does not separate candidate indices.

findings.reason: F0003:S2:T3:A29 explicitly states that the mouse regimen mimics human 1 g q8h. This supports its humanized origin, while model, scaling, prediction and freeze records are NOT_FOUND in this item. The regimen cannot tune scaling; the human dose is design context rather than an observed human outcome.
findings.needed_material: Retain the humanized-origin restriction and obtain the workflow freeze and access records from their designated producing tasks before translation and human-outcome release.

findings.reason: F0003:S2:T3:A27 provides source provenance, A29 describes groups of 3 mice, and A30 specifies median MIC summaries. Individual animals, concentration observations, CFU observations and response variability are NOT_FOUND. Reported fT>MIC values are parameters, while MICs are summaries; neither constitutes individual-animal PK or PD records. Numerical zeros in comparator fT>MIC cells remain zeros. Detection-limit definitions and censoring metadata are NOT_FOUND.
findings.needed_material: Preserve source coordinates, summary and reported-parameter status, exclusion markers, missing fields and literal zeros during preparation; confirm text-only stated values separately without fabricating animal identities.

findings.reason: This item provides mouse infection-model context, serum PK context and thigh site, with meropenem and ertapenem kept distinct. MIC medium, unchanged-versus-other-analyte characterization and binding matrix are NOT_FOUND. The item contains no concentration observations or rat/rabbit evidence. Its Mouse-sheet location and data do not alone establish workbook permission, broader coverage or model adequacy under DRQ01 and DRQ05.
findings.needed_material: Keep serum, thigh and unspecified MIC matrix contexts distinct; retain neutropenic and renally impaired state, comparator identity and unresolved analyte definitions. Review any proposed bridge or combination using its own source-supported justification.

findings.reason: The page includes ertapenem MICs, fT>MIC percentages and a comparator regimen, plus cyclophosphamide and uranyl nitrate pretreatments. These are retained for independent routing review and cannot substitute for meropenem inputs. The note's example MIC 0.047 also repeats a numeric value appearing in multiple MIC body cells without identifying a unique isolate or drug.
findings.needed_material: Route comparator and pretreatment context separately; confirm the example as contextual repetition during stated-value review without inventing a unique row association.
